scenes.text: This tutorial covers Import Project. Bring another laboratory's images, masks, and measurement table into a spaCR project.
Open Import Project from the Data and batch runs section. Provide images, optional masks, a measurement table, and stable external identifiers.
In the main configuration area, map foreign columns onto spaCR identifiers, channels, object types, plate metadata, and provenance fields.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. validate joins, missing values, image-mask alignment, and duplicate identifiers before import.
When the workflow finishes, the standardized project preserves links back to every original file and identifier.
